| Standard deviation | 1.49 | 52.16 | 4.22 | 72.06 |

The standard deviation of a flat patch of background, 30 by 20 pixels, in the image of the figure. Before the filters it is only noise. Global equalization stretches it a lot, since most pixels of the image are background. AHE stretches it the most, since the tiles in flat areas have one tall histogram bin and so a very steep curve. The clip limit of CLAHE caps that slope.
